I'm Daniel and intend to write about topics such as statistical modeling, machine learnign, biomechanical research, music, or whatever comes to my mind.

I’m a big fan of Free and Open Source Software and the idea of open science in general. You’ll usually find me coding in R and Python. I am the author of the R package [funbootband](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/funbootband/index.html).

Off the clock, I switch gears and jam on my bass and guitar. 🎸 If you are into Doom/Stoner music, check out my band [Ufo Krause](https://ufokrause.org/)
